C34.content_en:
Ways to see keywords related to a website — and how the main tools compare

When you look for topics for your blog, you want to see which words a site you admire is tied to. Enter a domain and this tool lists up to 100 keywords related to that site, with monthly volume and difficulty.

* You can choose 100, 300 or 1,000 rows (the default is 100). Where the text below says "100", it describes the default. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.024 per call for 100 rows (measured)From a domain: 100 related keywords with volume and difficulty. Save as CSV
Google Search ConsoleFreeShows the searches your own site actually appeared for. You cannot view other sites
Ahrefs Site ExplorerSubscription (see the official site for plans)Finds the keywords a site ranks for, including other people's sites
SemrushSubscription (see the official site for plans)Also finds keywords a site ranks for (see the official site for features)

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Works on other people's domains. Try the domain of a blog you want to learn from.
  • About $0.024 for 100 rows. About 40 per $1.
  • A few seconds. We measured about 5 seconds on screen (4.9 seconds for target.com).
  • Volume included. Sort candidates by volume.
  • Save as CSV.

When it is not the right fit

  • You want the rankings the site really holds → these are keywords the API returns as related to the site. Whether they are rankings, this tool cannot tell.
  • You want more than 100 rows → choose 300 or 1,000 in the count field. target.com had about 1.1 million in total.
  • You want a table with every difficulty filled in → DataForSEO says keyword difficulty needs SERP data, so it is only available for keywords in its SERP database.In our target.com test, 7 of the 30 rows kept in the sample were blank. The median volume was 10 on blank rows and 90 on rows with a value, so blanks leaned toward rarely searched words.
  • Many rows are words unique to the site, such as store names and places (target.com example: "williamsburg general store" and "target store 3991").

This tool does one thing: show 100 keywords related to a domain, with volume and difficulty.

FAQ

Why are many difficulty values blank?

DataForSEO says keyword difficulty needs SERP data, so it is only available for keywords in its SERP database.In our target.com test, 7 of the 30 rows kept in the sample were blank. The median volume was 10 on blank rows and 90 on rows with a value, so blanks leaned toward rarely searched words.

Is this a list of keywords the site ranks for?

No. These are candidates the API returns as related to the site, not the site's rankings.

Why only 100?

The default is 100 per call; you can choose 300 or 1,000. 100 rows cost $0.024.

What do country and language change?

The market for the numbers. The United States and English give US English volumes.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?

C36.content_en:
Ways to find phrases that contain a keyword — and how the main tools compare

If you pick blog or book topics from search data, you want promising long-tail phrases, the longer word combinations. Enter one keyword and this tool lists up to 100 phrases that contain it, with monthly volume and difficulty.

* You can choose 100, 300 or 1,000 rows (the default is 100). Where the text below says "100", it describes the default. See the table at the top for the cost.

Method / toolPricing modelNotes
This tool (DataForSEO)Pay per request. About $0.024 per call for 100 rows (measured)Phrases that contain your word, with volume and difficulty, 100 rows. Save as CSV
Google search-box suggestions (by hand)FreeCandidates shown as you type, without volume
Ahrefs Keywords Explorer (Matching terms)Subscription (see the official site for plans)Lists phrases that contain your word, with numbers
UbersuggestSubscription (see the official site for plans)Keyword suggestions from a seed word (see the official site for features)

Checked in November 2026. Prices change — confirm on each vendor's official site before you buy.

Why use this tool

  • Long combinations in a row. See long-tail candidates together.
  • The total is visible. Phrases containing "how to start a blog" totaled 1,675 (measured).
  • About $0.024 for 100. About 40 per $1.
  • A few seconds. We measured under 1 second for the US sample.
  • Save as CSV.

When it is not the right fit

  • Spelling-only variants get in the way → rows like "how to start a blog", "how to start a blog blog" and "start a blog how to" appear almost the same. We do not filter them.
  • You want a table with every difficulty filled in → DataForSEO says keyword difficulty needs SERP data, so it is only available for keywords in its SERP database. In our US test ("how to start a blog"), none of the 30 rows kept in the sample were blank, but blanks do occur: in a test in Japan with a Japanese keyword, 11 of 100 rows were blank.
  • You want more than 100 → choose 300 or 1,000 in the count field.
  • Similar-meaning words that do not contain your word do not appear (the "keywords in the same genre" tool fits that).

This tool does one thing: show up to 100 keywords that contain your keyword, with volume and difficulty.

FAQ

Why do near-identical phrases repeat?

The API treats a different space or word order as a different keyword. We show them as they come.

Why is difficulty sometimes blank?

DataForSEO says keyword difficulty needs SERP data, so it is only available for keywords in its SERP database. In our US test ("how to start a blog"), none of the 30 rows kept in the sample were blank, but blanks do occur: in a test in Japan with a Japanese keyword, 11 of 100 rows were blank.

Can I see all 1,675?

Yes. You can choose 100, 300 or 1,000 (the default is 100).

What do country and language change?

The market for the numbers. The United States and English give US English volumes.

Can I sign up with a free email address?

No. DataForSEO does not accept free email providers. See What is DataForSEO?
